headline: Lumen Technologies (LUMN) Appoints John M. Hinshaw To Its Board
summary: Lumen Technologies (NYSE:LUMN) has appointed John M. Hinshaw to its Board of Directors. Hinshaw brings executive experience from HSBC, Hewlett-Packard, Boeing, and Verizon Wireless. The appointment introduces additional leadership and operational expertise to Lumen's board. Lumen Technologies operates in the communications and network services space, where companies face ongoing demands around reliability, security, and modernization of infrastructure.
